name: MONEYCALL | [Hood/DarkRP]
desc:
MONEYCALL is a hood game based off of GTA and DarkRP.
You are not forced to RP in character.
You are free to be uniquely you and carve out a name for yourself in the streets of Redwood City.

----------
Money. Guns. Cars. Houses. Printers. Trash Bins?!

The criminal underworld of Redwood City calls for a new top dog.
Will you rise to the challenge?

💵 Start a money printing Empire
🏠 Build a beautiful house
🔪 Raid others for their cash
🚘 Drive awesome cars and flex on others
♻ Collect trash for money

Warning: You drop your guns on death (besides Glock per session)

PRESS [F] TO GET OUT OF DRIVE SEAT OF VEHICLES!
